Rationale: silence and a guessed Via are not confirmation
Rationale: submitted answers are authoritative over unsent drafts

Rationale: importance is fixed before reading the CV so the CV cannot bias it
Rationale: cap open-ended research and subagent cost

Rationale: owning a repo is not authorship and forks prove none
